balance_audit.exact_pair_rule: A and B load the same float64 state with identical geometry, rendering, robot state, first RGB, probe order, instruction property, and controller; only body mass/inertia assignment differs

inward_orientation.rule: place paddle on the nearer y-boundary side so the candidate-facing normal points toward lane interior; exact ties use lower side for front and upper side for back
inward_orientation.source: initial ordinary RGB localization and frozen lane geometry

paired_test.paired_interval: two-sided 95% Student-t interval for 12 exact-pair contrasts
paired_test.primary_one_sided_test: exact sign test discarding and reporting zeros

position_order_control.adjusted_model: OLS pair contrast on centered initial back x, back y, back lane margin, and back-first indicator with HC3 95% interval

manifest.sham_action: hold at the high-clearance approach-start pose and execute the same five-step response action sequence without descending into contact
